expanded_title: Wolfgang Flops a Set With Pocket Deuces at Champions Social Club Dallas: How Did He Know Something Was Wrong?
expanded_deck: Holding pocket deuces (2♠ 2♥) on a 2♣ 8♦ 4♥ flop at Champions Social Club in Dallas, Wolfgang Poker hits bottom set — and senses danger on the feature felt.
expanded_body:
Originally posted October 11, 2026.

Wolfgang flops a set with pocket deuces at Champions Social Club in Dallas… how did he know something was wrong?!

In this feature-table highlight from Champions Social Club Dallas (https://www.facebook.com/reel/1662206285253519/), poker vlogger Wolfgang Poker woke up with pocket deuces (2♠ 2♥) and spiked bottom set right on the 2♣ 8♦ 4♥ rainbow flop — only for his instincts to kick in as the action unfolded.

Watch the full hand on Facebook and tell us how you would play bottom set in Wolfgang's spot.

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
